title: Identity and associativity of the normalized module derived direct-image compositor
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be an admissible commutative condensed coefficient ring of [sk-def-localizing-closure]. For every scheme $T$ put $D_T=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_T})$, where $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ is the pulled-back ring and the category is the ordinary unbounded module-object derived category [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, sk-def-sfb-module-objects, sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Use the module direct images and inverse images of [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback], with the coefficient identifications induced by composition of pullbacks from the point and the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention]. For arbitrary scheme maps $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ\xrightarrow hW$, write $\kappa_{g,f}:R(gf)_*\xrightarrow{\sim}Rg_*Rf_*$ for the comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition], transported through [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. On a K-injective representative it is the inverse of the termwise module compositor of [def-sfb-module-lower-star-comp]. The two natural transformations satisfy
$$ (Rh_*\kappa_{g,f})\circ\kappa_{h,gf}=(\kappa_{h,g}Rf_*)\circ\kappa_{hg,f}. $$
The canonical comparison $R(1_T)_*\cong1_{D_T}$ is induced by the sectionwise identity direct image. With this comparison, both identity compositor constraints are identities. All equalities include canonical functor associators and the transport along equality of composite scheme maps. No properness, density, Noetherian hypothesis, or field of definition is required.

proof.text: Use the existing module upperStarLowerStarAdjunction and exactness of upperStar to install preservation of K-injectives by lowerStar, by lem-weil-pbc-right-adjoint-preserves-kinjective. Apply the existing canonical composition isomorphism of lem-fin-kinjective-derived-composition to lowerStarComp. Reuse UnboundedSectionsLocalization.compIso_objQ from lem-sfb-unbounded-sections-localization (made public in its original module): at Q(I), successive K-injective computation isomorphisms cancel the composite unit. Functor.rightDerivedFunctorNatTrans_app_Q_obj applies the inverse ordinary compositor termwise. These two calculations give exactly module_derived_compositor_normalization, including the inverse compositor direction.

Specialize the already proved generic Functor.rightDerivedFunctorCompIso'_assoc from WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.ProEtale.FiniteCoefficient.Derived.LowerStarComp to the six module pushforward functors. The hypothesis is lowerStarComp_assoc, with lowerStarCongr appended to the left composite to account for scheme associativity. Functoriality of rightDerivedFunctorNatIso identifies derivation of this appended comparison with the composite of derived comparisons (private helper derivedComp_post). Invert the resulting equality of natural isomorphisms and cancel the equality-transport inverse. Componentwise the derived functor associator is the identity, giving the displayed module_derived_compositor_coherence.

The comparison (identity).rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory followed by mapDerivedCategoryIdIso equals the generic rightDerivedFunctorIdIso by right-derived extensionality: both send the derived unit to the identity. Naturality with quotientCompQhIso and rightDerivedFunctorIdIso_fac_app identify its component at Q(I) with the inverse unit followed by Q(mapHomologicalComplexIdIso). Combine this with rightDerivedFunctorNatTrans_app_Q_obj for lowerStarId to obtain module_derived_identity_normalization. For both unit laws use the generic rightDerivedFunctorCompIso'_hom_of_iso_id_left/right from the same adopted source module. lowerStarComp_id_left/right identify their ordinary compositors with lowerStarComp followed by lowerStarCongr. Apply derivedComp_post, identify the derived identity as above, and cancel the derived compositor hom against its inverse. This gives both displayed module unit constraints.
